High tea , high price , high disappointment
Mar 2023 • Friends
We treated ourselves to High Tea at the Da Lat Palace terrace with great anticipation of what a five star hotel with such an illustrious past would serve… wrong thinking! 

Perhaps it was the dry climate and the buffet style presentation which contributed to very dry sandwiches, or a tea bag in a single pot of tea which set the low standard. 

The petit fours looked delicious and were beautifully presented but failed to deliver on taste and flavour. There were many cake bases but the only pastry was a small quiche. We were hoping for some of the French pastries and macaroons, at least. The range of savoury was also limited and I suspect if u were looking for vegetarian or gluten free options you may need to choose another experience. 

There is a better price 99,000 VND per person from Mon to Thursday but this was a Friday and the 250, 000 VND price tag could not be justified even in such a beautiful setting. 

We did not look at the main menu and in hindsight we might have been better off ordering a single dessert and a coffee. 

We hope this review will help improve the experience for future guests and boost the reputation of such a beautiful and elegant hotel. 

Please highlight some of the beautiful local tea and coffee , consider how to maintain freshness , and create different flavours.

Good Christmas Dinner
Dec 2017 • Couples
Some friends and I decided to have a dinner at this restaurant on Christmas eve while we were in Dalat. It was quite a last minute decision and the restaurant at first was reluctant to take the reservation and demanded a deposit. We managed to talk them out of it. The restaurant has a very charming atmosphere with colonial setting - 5-star for the ambience.

They had a pre-set Christmas menu. However, since some of us don't eat meat, we managed to change the meat items to seafood. The seafood that I had was only okay, nothing great. The service was quite slow, maybe due to the fact it was full house on Christmas eve. The bill took forever to be prepared. The wait staff were all polite. Apart from great ambience, I don't think the restaurant gave value for money.

Substantially overpriced cold food
Feb 2015 • Couples
We had something to celebrate and thought we'd go to the most luxurious place we could find. The staff was really very nice and helpful but the service could not save the food. We waited quite some time and were then served a nice steak and good prawns with refrigerator-cold garniture. Prawns came with both cold pasta and cold rice, steak had luke-warm potatoes on an icy cold plate. Still, we ordered dessert and had a cake that was obviously not from the same day. We were the only ones there and joked that it seemed like a haunted house. We paid as much for this meal as we had spent the entire week leading up to this. It was not even close to being worth it.
